thread:
Alice Chen: quick sync — we need to align on the Spark streaming adapter (CDC -> vector ingestion) + Snow Delta share handoff for the Databricks partner. Goal: certification checklist, perf targets, and announcement window.

Mateo Ruiz: timeline? are we talking near-real-time CDC or batched micro-batches?

Alice Chen: primary flow is CDC through Spark Structured Streaming with micro-batches (1–5s), fall back to 1-min batches during heavy load. partner asks for <200ms token latency from query to result for 4k context vectors in dedicated mode.

Dan Li: 200ms post-query is tight for that context size. We should split responsibilities: 1) ingest path (Spark -> transform -> vector DB) 2) query path (inference + reranker). Which piece is partner certifying?

Alice Chen: partner wants the connector cert for the ingest side (Delta -> vector DB) and a joint benchmark for end-to-end QPS at target latency on their instance types. Redwood will provide reference config and Dedicated guidance.

Priya Singh: legal / data residency check — Snow Delta shares might carry PII depending on customer; partner legal needs our DPA + SOC snippets. Can we provide a brief that lists where data is in transit vs at rest and what KMS is used?

Alice Chen: yes — we'll attach the KMS/HSM integration doc and the minimal DPA excerpt. I'll pull that into the cert packet.

Mateo Ruiz: technical questions: what vector DB are we validating first? Qdrant or Weaviate? And which quantization/embedding size?

Dan Li: start with Qdrant v1.12 on their managed offering. Embedding dims 1536, float32 for E2E tests, then 8-bit quantization for cost bench. We'll also run 512-dim cheap embedding baseline.

ConnectorBot: CI check: spark-adapter e2e smoke tests passed on branch feature/spark-vector-1905 — 14/14.

Priya Singh: PR for DPA snippets please target legal-review@redwood by Thu. Need country-by-country data flow diagram for EU catalysts.

Alice Chen: action items: 
- Mateo: draft ingest runbook (commands, configs, monitoring signals) by Wed EOD.
- Dan: run Dedicated latency bench script (attached) on qdrant-managed with 4k vectors and post numbers to this thread by Fri.
- Priya: coordinate legal packet and run it by partner counsel — deliver Tue.
- Me: assemble cert packet + partner-facing README and a risk summary for marketing.

Mateo Ruiz: excerpt from runbook (draft):
```
# Spark Structured Streaming config snippet
spark.conf.set("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", "200")
spark.readStream.format("delta").load("/mnt/delta/events")
  .selectExpr("id", "embedding")
  .writeStream.foreachBatch { (df, batchId) =>
    // serialize embeddings -> vector DB client
    df.foreachPartition { it => client.bulkUpsert(it) }
  }
```

Dan Li: latency bench command (local):
```
./bench.sh --host qdrant.partner.net --emb_dim 1536 --qps 200 --context 4096 --threads 16
```
I'll post results here.

ConnectorBot: note: marketplace listing checklist item "security-scan" pending vendor-confirmation.

Alice Chen: scheduling — propose a 30m sync on Thursday 10:00 PT with partner's integration PM (they confirmed tentative). If anyone cannot make it, flag now.

Priya Singh: Thu 10 works for me.

Mateo Ruiz: fine. I'll bring the runbook and sample logs.

Dan Li: OK, I'll have initial numbers but might need a quick follow-up once I tune batching.

Alice Chen: thanks all — I'll create the shared drive folder and upload the initial cert template. Will ping partner after legal ack. :thumbsup:

ConnectorBot: reminder scheduled: cert-template-v1 uploaded to //shared/partners/spark-vector/ — autogenerated link: https://files.redwood.internal/partners/1905/spark-vector-cert-v1

Alice Chen: perfect — closing for now, will post updates in thread.
